description: This file defines the GrainAddress class, which represents an address for a grain in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes properties like GrainId, ActivationId, SiloAddress, and MembershipVersion, and methods for comparison, string representation, and address creation.

classes.name: GrainAddress
classes.description: A class representing the address of a grain, including its ID, activation ID, silo location, and membership version, with comparison and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this GrainAddress and another object.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this GrainAddress and another GrainAddress.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if the GrainAddress matches another considering activation IDs.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the address properties.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the GrainAddress.

methods.name: ToFullString
methods.description: Provides a detailed string representation including membership version.

methods.name: NewActivationAddress
methods.description: Creates a new GrainAddress for a specific silo and grain ID with a new activation ID.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Creates a GrainAddress with specified silo, grain ID, and activation ID.
